name: Cooler Master Hyper 212 3DHP Black ARGB CPU Cooler
shortDescription: Cooler Master Hyper 212 3DHP Black ARGB CPU Air Cooler (Innovative 3DHP 3D Heat Pipe Technology / 120mm Addressable Gen 2 RGB PWM Fan / All-Black Aluminum Fins / Intel LGA 1851 1700 & AMD AM5 AM4 Ready / MAY-T2HP-217
descriptionHtml:
Cooler Master Hyper 212 3DHP Black ARGB CPU Air Cooler (Innovative 3DHP 3D Heat Pipe Technology / 120mm Addressable Gen 2 RGB PWM Fan / All-Black Aluminum Fins / Intel LGA 1851 1700 & AMD AM5 AM4 Ready / MAY-T2HP-217PA-R1 / 1-Year Local Warranty)

Experience next-generation CPU thermal dissipation with the Cooler Master Hyper 212 3DHP Black ARGB Air Cooler, available at Turbo Computer Egypt backed by a full 1-Year official local agent warranty layout. Engineered around revolutionary 3D Heat Pipe (3DHP) architecture, this high-performance tower cooler integrates dual 3DHP elements with high-density black aluminum fins to dramatically enhance heat transfer efficiency across modern high-core CPUs. It comes equipped with a silent 120mm Addressable Gen 2 RGB PWM fan featuring durable Loop Dynamic Bearings, operating smoothly from 0 up to 2050 RPM while outputting strong static pressure up to 2.69 mmH2O at whisper-quiet noise levels peaking at just 22.6 dBA. Designed with a sleek black stealth aesthetic, it provides native installation hardware for the latest Intel LGA 1851 / 1700 and AMD AM5 / AM4 sockets.
